rules.title: Slow server response (TTFB)
rules.description: Server response time exceeded 800 ms (web.dev "good" TTFB threshold) from the crawler's location. Lab measurement from one location; not field data.
rules.fix: Add caching (CDN, page cache), reduce server work, check database queries.
rules.verify: Measure TTFB from multiple regions or via CrUX.

rules.title: HTML served without compression
rules.description: HTML responses larger than 10 KB were served without gzip/br compression, increasing transfer time.
rules.fix: Enable gzip or Brotli compression on the server/CDN for text responses.
rules.verify: Fetch with Accept-Encoding and check Content-Encoding.

rules.title: Core Web Vitals not measured
rules.description: Core Web Vitals (LCP ≤2.5 s, INP ≤200 ms, CLS ≤0.1 at p75) are field metrics. Searvex does not have field data unless a CrUX API key is configured; no CWV values are estimated.
rules.fix: Configure SEARVEX_CRUX_API_KEY or review the Core Web Vitals report in Search Console.

rules.title: Core Web Vitals not in "good" range (field data)
rules.description: CrUX field data at the 75th percentile is outside the "good" threshold for at least one Core Web Vital.
rules.fix: Optimise the failing metric (LCP: server/resource load; INP: main-thread work; CLS: reserved space).

sources.title: Google: Core Web Vitals and Google Search results

rules.title: Poor Lighthouse lab performance on a sampled template
rules.description: A Lighthouse run through PageSpeed Insights (mobile, one simulated load) scored the page below 50, Lighthouse's "poor" band. Lab values vary between runs and do not decide Core Web Vitals (field data does); the metrics show where the load is slow (LCP, total blocking time, layout shift). The page is a sample of its URL template.
rules.fix: Work on the slowest lab metrics of the template (LCP: server response and the largest image or text block; TBT: long JavaScript tasks; CLS: reserved space for media and late content), then re-run with --lab.
rules.verify: Re-run the audit with --lab, and confirm with CrUX field data (searvex crux auth) once it is available.
